title: Flower Bed
description: Adds a Flower Bed block that lets you quickly duplicate flowers using bone meal.
body:
![Flower Bed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1fa6ff10f44f7b263ab8aebd9e44e693f597ea29.png)

This mod introduces a new functional block: the Flower Bed.

![Recept](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/677fc63d23a44dc74fcbfde6a278d9687b42f4ce.png)

Simply place any flower and some bone meal into the Flower Bed to receive 4 identical flowers!

![Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40a2f8c7d3daf907177bf5df2db1944ab4722535.png)

Perfect for gardeners, decorators, and builders—grow as many flowers as you need with ease.
The mod is fully compatible with popular modpacks and supports all vanilla Minecraft flowers.
